title: feat(state): bind nuryel.state/1 read/write/subscribe to the store and expose it over MCP
context:
One implementation of the three verbs over a HunchStore (src/store/stateBinding.ts),
a per-scope git-native change ledger (src/store/changeLedger.ts, .hunch/changes/),
and four MCP tools (nuryel_capabilities, nuryel_read, nuryel_write, nuryel_subscribe)
that are a thin transport over it.

Homing is decided by scope: the repository partition lands where captures land today;
organization/team/user partitions land in the overlay only and are refused without one.
Writes run grants -> provenance -> i Touches invariant(s): con_902759b3dc (All JSON writes to .hunch/ must be atomic (temp-file + rename) so an interrupted write can never truncate the index); con_a87360128b (Semantic vectors are a derived layer in SQLite, never the source of truth; reconcile by content hash on reindex); con_e04226bd05 (The MCP server must stay client-agnostic: all assistants point to the same .hunch/ graph; no Claude-only behavior in the server).
decision: Introduced src/core, src/integrations, src/mcp, src/store, test/mcp-state.test.ts, test/state-binding.test.ts: added IdempotencyEntry, Ledger, ledgerFile, emptyLedger, readLedger, writeLedger, PendingChange, appendChanges; new dep(s): node:fs, node:path, node:crypto, zod, node:test, node:assert/strict; 4 new file(s).
consequences: Adds dependency: node:fs, node:path, node:crypto, zod, node:test, node:assert/strict, node:os, @modelcontextprotocol/sdk/client/index.js, @modelcontextprotocol/sdk/inMemory.js, node:child_process.
